items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: I used to go down to Clark-Monroe's, told, Wilson used to be there.

ctx.x: ... I was just learning how to play -- I used to go down to Clark-Monroe's, told, Wilson used to be there. All the great guys used to come there. I had in my mind to play ... they asked me --- whisper it in my ear, say "hey man, look I'm gonna play somethin' here so you lay out, hear?" That musta been how bad I was. But I was determined. I couldn't keep up with some of them cats. But I finally found myself doin' enough to keep up with them, and get a little gig every week end hopefully 5 dollars, 3 dollars, and…
Did you ever play with Charlie Christian
